card.name: Opening of a quoted statement
card.fires_on: The comma or opening quotation mark right after a speech verb or phrase (said, ask me, saying to herself, a statement like) just before directly quoted words, often first-person.

modes.label: Quote opener after speech verb
modes.description: Comma or opening quote mark right after said, ask, or saying, before the quoted speech begins.

modes.label: Opening of an imagined first-person line
modes.description: Quote mark or first word of a sample line the speaker might say or think, such as a role-play opener.

card.writes: It suppresses first-person words like my, myself and I (including Chinese forms), so the quoted speech is less likely to begin with first-person words.
card.plain: It fires at the point where a quotation is about to start after words like "said" or "asks".
